newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE chastises brokers over bond trades.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE chastises brokers over bond trades.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Tuesday that a dealer and partner at stockbroker De Witt Morgan & Co had pleaded guilty to failing to act in the best interest, good name or welfare of the exchange.

Heyns Weyer, the dealer, had agreed to pay 120,000 rand into the JSE's Guarantee Fund while Willem Morgan, the partner, would pay 35,000 rand, the JSE said in a statement. The two will also contribute 45,000 rand towards JSE costs.
The exchange said Weyer had admitted negligent actions regarding transactions in bonds and bond options, while Morgan had failed to detect or prevent his actions.
Neither Weyer, Morgan nor officials at De Witt Morgan & Co were immediately available to comment.
